name: autoresearch
description: Research-design skills grounded in top systems papers. create-novelty turns a research topic into an OSDI/SOSP-grade novelty and experiment plan, using a library of 100 dissected OSDI/SOSP papers (2016–2026).

interface.shortDescription: Design OSDI-grade novelty and experiments for a topic.
interface.longDescription: Autoresearch helps design systems research. create-novelty takes a research topic and works out a problem worth solving, the strawman and baselines down to their root cause, an insight that makes the design obvious in hindsight, and the experiments (including per-novelty ablations) a top-venue reviewer would expect. It draws on 100 OSDI/SOSP papers dissected the same way.
defaultPrompt: Use create-novelty to design an OSDI-level novelty for my topic
What would make this idea an OSDI paper?
Design the experiments and ablations for this systems idea
